mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Dwynen's Elite: "When this creature enters, if you control another Elf, create a 1/1 green
# Elf Warrior creature token."
# M21 Turret Ogre's verified "When this creature enters, if you control another creature with
# power 4 or greater, ..." (B2a-turret-ogre): the intervening "if" is the condition
# CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 over your creatures other than this one (FNot(IS_SOURCE)), here the Elves
# (a tribal noun: SUBTYPE_EQ plus TYPE_EQ 'Creature', ZNR Chilling Trap's "If you control a
# Wizard"). The token: KHM Skemfar Elderhall's "1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token", one.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=FAtom(
        pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE,
        count=QConst(value=1),
        inner_filter=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.SUBTYPE_EQ, string_value='Elf'),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    effect=A(Verb.CREATE_TOKEN, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'tokens': TokenSpec(
            name='Elf Warrior',
            type_line='Creature — Elf Warrior',
            types=('Creature',),
            subtypes=('Elf', 'Warrior'),
            power=QConst(value=1),
            toughness=QConst(value=1),
            keywords=(),
            abilities=(),
            colors=('G',),
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, if you control another Elf, create a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token.
clauses.ir: abilities[0] (condition CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1 other Elf creature you control; CREATE_TOKEN one 1/1 green Elf Warrior)

mapping.notes: Turret Ogre's verified intervening 'if you control another ...' (CONTROLLER_IS YOU, FNot(IS_SOURCE), CONTROLLER_COUNT_GE 1) over Elf creatures (Chilling Trap's 'a Wizard'); Skemfar Elderhall's 1/1 green Elf Warrior token, one.
